dumbbell-squat.criteria: Two dumbbells at sides, shoulder-width stance and slight toe turnout; controlled hip and knee flexion, heels remain planted, knees follow toes.

1-5-rep-lunge.criteria: Reverse step, full descent, partial rise, return to bottom, then stand and bring rear foot forward. Source demonstrates one dumbbell; this illustration uses two at the sides, a loading variant supported by Catalyst Athletics.

kettlebell-reverse-lunge.criteria: Reverse step with upright trunk and controlled descent. Source explicitly permits kettlebells at the sides. Two suitcase-held kettlebells; repeated same side then switch outside demonstration.

sourceKind: Procedural skinned demonstration with original geometry, not copied footage.
limits: Eight-second illustrative cycle. No individualized load, clinical prescription or exhaustive continuous triangle collision certification. Device verification not performed.
